title: Training Criterion Root-Cause Verification
summary: Walk-forward selection optimizes trade-simulation PF and robustness while never recording or rejecting models with zero BUY-zone coverage. The frozen winner (logistic_strong_reg__stable_top3) achieved PF≈1.31 with 99.9% sell-zone probabilities (22U). SELL-only models pass selection. This is the earliest decision that explicitly permitted deployment of a degenerated classifier.
